title: A thought experiment
heading: You're the manager
caption: You hired four excellent freelancers for one party. You are the only link between them.

task.label: Task
task.text: Plan the summer party: 200 colleagues, five offices, 20 June

rule: They talk to no one unless you tell them to.

goal.label: Goal
goal.text: 20 June: everyone celebrates together and gets home safely

manager.label: You're the manager
manager.question: Your job: a plan so all four reach the goal. What do you do?

now-you-are-the-manager.title: Now you're the manager
now-you-are-the-manager.script: Now you're the manager. Same summer party, 200 colleagues from five offices, on the 20th of June. This time you don't plan it yourself: you have four freelancers, one each for Activities, Travel, Venue and Food and drinks.

four-price-freelancers.title: Four PRICE freelancers
four-price-freelancers.script: They are excellent, and they are the PRICE freelancers: probabilistic, relentless, informed, confident, and every word billed. And there is one rule: they talk to no one unless you tell them to. You are the only link between them.

your-job.title: Your job
your-job.script: The goal is that everyone celebrates together and gets home safely. Your job: a plan so all four reach the goal. What do you do? (pause) Keep this question in mind for the whole Episode; we collect the answers at the end.
